title: Google Job posting
statusNote: Active; job experience in Google Search. Payment-required postings are not allowed.
notes: jobLocation is not required when applicantLocationRequirements is present (a 100% remote job).

Not checked: validThrough is required only for postings that expire; applicantLocationRequirements and jobLocationType TELECOMMUTE are required for 100% remote jobs; if experienceInPlaceOfEducation is true both experienceRequirements and educationRequirements must be present.

Conditions: jobLocation is NOT required if applicantLocationRequirements is present (100% remote job); jobLocation must include addressCountry. jobLocationType=TELECOMMUTE and applicantLocationRequirements are 'required' for 100% remote jobs (page lists them under recommended with 'required if' wording); remote jobs need at least one eligible country via applicantLocationRequirements (preferred) or the jobLocation country. validThrough is 'required for job postings that have an expiration date' (omit if none). hiringOrganization: use name 'confidential' for anonymous employers; logo ratio must be 0.75-2.5. description must be HTML; title must not be the same as description and must not use `name`. employmentType values: FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, CONTRACTOR, TEMPORARY, INTERN, VOLUNTEER, PER_DIEM, OTHER (repeatable). baseSalary is MonetaryAmount (employers only); unitText one of HOUR, DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR. educationRequirements.credentialCategory values: high school, associate degree, bachelor degree, professional certificate, postgraduate degree (education/experience properties are marked beta).
If experienceInPlaceOfEducation is true, both experienceRequirements and educationRequirements must be present.
